breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 240 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.2.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states 'dt = 0.001 for 240 total time steps' alongside 'Solve to final time T = 0.2'. These are contradictory (240 × 0.001 = 0.24 ≠ 0.2). The ground truth resolves this by using 200 steps (200 × 0.001 = 0.2). The agent failed to correct the step count to 200 and instead repeated the erroneous 240 steps from the incomplete prompt.
